sunset_conditions: The task force issues a recommendation AND a Zoning Regulation text amendment has been passed into law. (Physical page 6, § 6.I.1.)
Alternatively, the Comprehensive Rezoning process has concluded. (Physical page 6, § 6.I.2.)
Alternatively, no later than November 2, 2027. The amendment strikes “18 months after the Effective Date of this Act” and adds the underlined date “November 2, 2027.” (Physical page 7, § 6.I.3.)
exemptions: The Act does not apply to any State or local government entity or allied agencies, including the Howard County Public School System, Howard Community College, and the Howard County Library System. (Physical page 6, § 6.E.)

The Act does not prohibit redlines to a previously approved development plan OR administrative approvals associated with an existing building AND previously approved development plan. (Physical page 3, § 1.)
locators: Physical page 3, § 1: plan-submission prohibition, reference to the § 6.E exemption, and the redlines and administrative-approvals proviso.

Physical page 6, §§ 6.D–E: development-review provision and government-entity exemption.
Physical pages 6–7, § 6.I: three alternative sunset conditions.
Physical page 7, § 7: the Act becomes effective 61 days after enactment.
